description: Reader Reborn — Kiro hooks. Guardrails for spec-driven work on this repo. Hooks run in Kiro; they do not execute in the deployed app.

hooks.action: Require that .kiro/specs/reader-reborn/requirements.md and design.md already describe the change. If the change is not in the spec, update the spec first.
hooks.name: spec-before-code
hooks.note: Spec-driven development: the spec is the source of truth, not an afterthought.
hooks.when: editing app.js, index.html, styles.css, or scripts/*.mjs

hooks.action: Block any content that looks like an API key, token, password, or credential (e.g. api_key, apikey, token=, Bearer, sk-). All APIs in this project are keyless by design.
hooks.name: no-secrets
hooks.note: Free-only rule: no keys in files, memory, or chat.

hooks.action: Never add .kiro (or .kiro/*) to .gitignore. The submission requires /.kiro at the repo root.
hooks.name: kiro-dir-guard

hooks.action: Only original assets may be added. Never copy Google Reader's logo or trade dress or any third-party copyrighted asset.
hooks.name: original-assets-only
